scripts.test: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PYTHONPATH='backend'; pytest backend/tests --maxfail=1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location 'frontend'; npm run test -- --run"
scripts.lint: python -m compileall backend && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.cleanup: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path node_modules) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules }; if (Test-Path frontend/node_modules) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force frontend/node_modules }; Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -Filter __pycache__ -Force | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force; Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -Filter *.pyc -Force | Remove-Item -Force"
